topic.title: Painting Project
topic.description: Extracts a color palette from an image using the colorgram library and recreates it as a dot painting with turtle. Combines external libraries with turtle graphics.

learningNotes.whatILearned: Installing and using the colorgram library to extract RGB color tuples from images and positioning turtles on a grid to create a dot painting.
learningNotes.challenges: Getting the grid positioning calculation right and installing colorgram in the project environment.
learningNotes.nextSteps: Try different dot sizes, spacing, or source images for varied visual effects.

files.description: Dot painting with colors extracted from an image.
